# Bag of Holding

The block names no `card-type:`; the system has exactly one, so it is implied.
This paragraph is the note's `body`, which `content` reaches last — the block
sets `content` itself, so this text stays off the card.

```cardsmith
card:
  system: simple
  language: en
data:
  name: "Bag of Holding"
  content: "Holds far more than its size suggests."
  game-name: "Chronicles of the Ember Coast"
  card-type-label: "Magic Item"
```
